test_purpose: Bounded deterministic correctness, ABI and fallback checks; no timing/performance claims or browser qualification
runtime: isolated copy of ../package with exact rebuilt binaries

groups.name: All 7 captured/rebuilt module ABIs and initial memory
K-means zero, underflow, overflow and fallback outcome parity
SOM training, PCA and events against current scalar paths
Metric reconstructed row/rank/histogram and end-to-end scalar parity
RMCM exact/Float32 candidates, boundaries, batch tails and CSR filtering
Per-call ownership and workspace budget/unavailable-WASM fallbacks

limitations: Finite cases do not prove all-input numerical equivalence.
Historical elite scalar runtime is not bundled or independently re-executed; scalar parity uses the current sibling package.
Only the recorded Node runtime was newly exercised.
Historical RMCM pre-Float32 and experimental nearest module receive ABI/byte checks but not separate numerical qualification.
